title: FBI Photo B002
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance display with a central white crosshair reticle. The horizontal axis of the reticle is marked with numeric scale labels reading 15, 10, 5, then 5, 10, 15 on either side of center, with tick marks between them. The upper portion of the frame is a solid black band. Six black rectangular bars (resembling redaction blocks) are arranged symmetrically on the left and right sides at three vertical levels; several have lighter gray fade segments at their ends. A faint small dark dot appears near the center-right of the crosshair. The lower right area shows soft gradient shapes suggesting hazy terrain or hills. A timestamp overlay appears at the bottom left.

observations.claim: A white crosshair reticle is centered in the image
Horizontal scale is labeled 15, 10, 5 descending to center then 5, 10, 15 ascending
Six black rectangular bars are placed symmetrically in three rows on left and right
A timestamp '12/31/99 18:11:27' is displayed in the bottom left corner
The top of the image has a solid black horizontal band
Faint gradient shapes suggesting terrain appear in the lower right
